title: Sima Chengzhen
subtitle: A representative figure of the Shangqing Daoist tradition
shortSummary: Sima Chengzhen connects mountain cultivation, Daoist lineages and Tang imperial patronage.
curatorialDescription: Sima Chengzhen shows why Daoism cannot be reduced either to an abstract philosophy or to a single court institution. It was a historical network of people, mountains, lineages, texts and imperial relationships.
His entry must distinguish documented activity, traditional identity and later memory rather than replacing this complexity with one biographical date.
researchNote: This Alpha structured sample still needs versioned references for lineage, institutions and court encounters.
